observations.title: Saved package-type discovery is a bounded read with durable exact intent
observations.conclusion: Only observed integer ID/string label are projected; malformed/ambiguous/duplicate lists fail whole. Intent binds original actor authorization, profile revision and HMAC key fingerprint before transport. Only complete exact results become retained observations; unresolved intent remains distinguishable and cannot authorize imports.

observations.title: Imports and retail variants retain original provider/type identity without publishing
observations.conclusion: Current latest complete observation/profile/key/owner review required; canonical profile+type identity reuses original product, refusing earlier-key adoption. Explicit child variant has original canonical pair, new SKU/retail row, separate media history, exact idempotency identity and audit. All local rows/counts/audit share transaction.

observations.title: Publication/confirmation rejects stale commercial or provider context
observations.conclusion: Latest publication/no withdrawal, product revision/hash, active plan, exact mapping/hash/expiry, current enabled profile/encrypted-credential digest, exact newest complete observation, and active publisher+mapping reviewer auth versions all checked. Public projection excludes private mappings/credentials/cost.

observations.title: Primary-client checkout atomically records exact consent and unpaid period zero
observations.conclusion: Reject contact/support, re-read current primary client and project ownership under shared mutex/transaction. Review binds amount/currency/quantity=1/timezone/calendar/plan/publication/project; expiry <=900 seconds and next local midnight. Confirmation writes optional project, exact client+system agreement prefix, recurring prefix, unique first unpaid invoice/issuance, consent/result/counters/audit together. Replay checks retained graph/ownership and creates no second invoice.

observations.title: Checkout cannot use manual fulfillment or a substitute invoice/mapping
observations.conclusion: Order bound to exact original checkout invoice. Manual override refused before replay and excluded from assessment. Original mapping ID/digest required. Existing fulfillment still separately claims before I/O, rechecks order/payment/profile/credential before send, returns no dispatch authority on replay and retains unknown result conservatively.

observations.title: History loss and migration state fail closed
observations.conclusion: Rows/counters/exact witnesses and reciprocal original prefixes checked; missing checkout origins cannot become ordinary agreement. DDL explicit owner action, recognized resumable ordered steps only; histories validated before/after. File recovery blocks with retained publication history to preserve original images/history.
